notes.title: Welcome to Nivalis
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

If this is your first journey into the strangely inviting cyberpunk city of Nivalis, we envy you. 
We've been working on this city for over 7 years now. The cyberpunk voxel art style and its unique residents came to life for the first time with Cloudpunk and was later expanded in City of Ghosts, our full sequel-sized DLC. We're proud little bees as Cloudpunk is featured today on Steam. 

But we've not stopped working on the city since Cloudpunk launched 4 years (and the DLC a year later). In the upcoming game "Nivalis" you will be able to dive in much deeper, as your job will be managing a restaurant. Or maybe not just one, but a whole bunch of them. Ever since we came up with the visual style that made Cloudpunk what it is we thought 

[h3][i]"What would life be in that city?"[/i][/h3]

And we've always been a fan of presenting the game from the perspective of a "normal" citizen working a "regular" job, not a hero or a superhacker or anyone who has to shoot through hundreds of enemies to reach a goal. No, we find that in such a city even the most regular jobs can be exciting and we wanted to explore all angles. The same applies to Nivalis.

You’ll have to manage restaurants and nightclubs, go fishing, explore the city with your own boat and connect with the residents to forge friendships (and rivalries) to unfold all of their strange stories.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1488490/Nivalis/

Until the game hits the store, go ahead and dive into the city of Nivalis today by being a driver for the semi-legal Cloudpunk delivery service. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/746850/Cloudpunk/

[h2]Welcome to Nivalis![/h2]

notes.title: Nivalis is a Cyberpunk Slice-of-life Sim
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the next game we're working on.

[b]Nivalis[/b] is a cyberpunk [b]slice-of-life sim[/b] set in the Cloudpunk universe. Choose how to spend your time each day and discover the wonders and dangers of this cyberpunk voxel city - realistic weather simulation and night-day cycles included. 

[list]
[*]Grow your business.
[*]Manage, furnish and decorate your restaurant or nightclub.
[*]Furnish your apartment or buy a new one.
[*]Learn how to make the perfect dish or cocktail for your customers.
[*]Need a break? Why not go fishing or maybe explore the city.
[*]Grow your own food in greenhouses near the docks.
[*]Meet strangers, friends, customers, maybe lovers?
[/list]

This is Nivalis as you’ve never seen it before.

notes.title: City of Ghosts DLC Announcement
notes.content:
We're happy to announce Cloudpunk - City of Ghosts today, a full sequel-sized DLC coming soon to Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536370/Cloudpunk__City_of_Ghosts/

Delivery driver Rania is in trouble - again. After surviving the events of the original Cloudpunk, she’s drawn the ire of monolithic courier corporation Curzona. With debt collectors, homicidal cyborgs and at least one death cult on her trail, Rania might not have a single friend left in the city of Nivalis. Meanwhile, deadbeat gambler Hayse has been set an impossible task: to clear all his debts by the end of the night. Their stories overlap and intertwine in this expansive DLC, which exceeds the length of the original game.

[h3]City of Ghosts features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Experience the direct sequel to Cloudpunk, seeing Nivalis through eyes old and new.
[*]A brand new, fully-voiced campaign longer than the base game
[*]Their fate is in your hands: unlock different endings depending on choices you make in-game.
[*]Customise your HOVA and compete in breakneck street races. 
[*]Explore new areas, meet new characters, and experience new mysteries in a gorgeous futuristic cityscape. 
[/list]

“Going back to Nivalis has been a thrill,” says Marko Dieckmann, studio head of ION LANDS. “It might be a DLC, but City of Ghosts has a sequel’s worth of content. It’s a darker, tenser, more complex story, and we can’t wait for people to experience it.”

You can start to put [b]Cloudpunk - City of Ghosts[/b] on your wishlist today. We will soon announce the launch date.
To celebrate the announcement of City of Ghosts, Cloudpunk is currently on Sale with 40% off.

notes.title: Cloudpunk's cockpit update puts a camera behind the steering wheel
notes.content:
Ah, the hum of your hover-engine beneath your feet. The pitter-patter of rain on the windshield. The light glow of the GPS as your dispatch screen lights up. Until now, I could only imagine the interior of one of Cloudpunk‘s blocky hover-cabs. That’s all changed with today’s Cockpit Update, which puts you right in the drivers seat for a night’s shift – briefly cutting fares by a third for passengers who’re hopping on for the first time.

notes.title: Cockpit Update
notes.content:
The [b]Cockpit Update[/b] is here.  ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/746850/Cloudpunk/

Experience the city of Nivalis like never before with a fully immersive first person cockpit view. To see it in action, check out the new trailer right here, featuring music from cult synthwave artist [b]Perturbator[/b], with his track [b]Venger (feat. Greta Link)[/b]. We feel incredibly honored to have partnered with Perturbator for this update and we think the song fits our game perfectly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/d7010cb799b6adc76e4af59caae3759fb9173c17.png[/img]

While in the vehicle you can enter the cockpit view via the [b]V[/b] key or [b]DPAD Up[/b] on the controller. You can reassign this to another key that you'd prefer more. 
In cockpit you can steer your vehicle just like before, but driving will feel completely new. Feel the rain dropping on your windshield and the city and all the other cars swoosh by. You may also unlock your camera like before, which allows you to look around inside the car. Look out the side windows and even the new floor windows. Funky! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/20f12d351f51c33b71d5c93082ee02f91c7fe37c.png[/img]

When you approach a parking lot and slow down a bit, a holographic "below the car" view will appear on your windshield making it easier to navigation to the nearest parking slot. The hologram will automatically fade away if you drive off. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/8b4e0a53fba89b58403d90a6b712bc9be14a373a.png[/img]

Don't damage your car too much or the windshield will get cracks limiting your view.

We've also upgraded your apartment by making many of the apartment items interactable. Eat your pizza, take a closer look at your fish tank, turn on your TV and play a game on the retro game console. Try to beat Camus' highscore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/5e8c1af7f8e117a6f1bc0548e3de03d4e9001272.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/0e003df8825dc433a44c80218843cf0aa80b1036.png[/img]

Other changes in this update include performance improvements, smaller level design changes and much smoother controller input with the third and first person cameras. I (Marko) kinda prefer the controller for everything in the game now, but Roman is still a "keyboard+mouse boi" (his words). But we're happy that both feel really balanced and polished.

We hope you will enjoy this update as much we did making it. Let us know your thoughts in the comments below. We also welcome you on our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali.

There's more coming in the future, such as the big story update introducing new characters and bringing back old ones, a vehicle constructor and optional racing jobs. But these will take us longer to develop, it'll be like a second game. 

Enjoy!

Control Out

notes.title: Future Update Teaser
notes.content:
We're happy to be part of this year's [b]Gamescom[/b] and [b]Indie Arena Booth 2020[/b]! 
This year everything is different, so the whole Indie Arena Booth will take place online. You can join it here for free: [url=https://online.indiearenabooth.com/]Indie Arena Booth Online[/url]

In the last weeks since launch we have been testing and plotting behind the scenes to prepare a large update, for which we would like to reveal 2 screenshots right now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/af976b954c11c3e94045dbe34b2348d7a6d77130.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/d85866990b2f3f9ae80cb5535b727fa753d34ff5.png[/img]

Yes, we will bring a [b]cockpit view[/b] to Cloudpunk and it changes driving around the cyberpunk city of Nivalis completely. 

Now, the details of this update are yet to be announced officially, but you know us. We like to tease a little bit and make you excited about what the future brings for the game. What we want to say at this point is that this update will bring a comprehensive story update with multiple hours of gameplay, introducing new characters and bringing back old characters. Furthermore it will add a set of new features around vehicle customization and racing.

We have been prototyping racing and decided we want it to be racing through the city as you know it. There are no specific race tracks, most of these races are semi-legal events through the city of Nivalis. So knowing it well will give you an advantage. As everything that happened to Rania, she will be pulled right into this without much of a choice. She's not a racer, but she needs to become one. 

Adding racing will not entirely change the rather chill nature of the game, however. It will add a nice challenge after you got to know the city. 

Use the comments below to let us know what you think!
You are also welcome to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali.


Control out.

notes.title: Performance & Smoothness
notes.content:
We're calling this update the [b]Butter Update[/b]. Butter?! ːsteamhappyː
Yes, because it was our intention to make everything smooth like butter and remove all remaining micro-stutters happening in either low or high frames per second.

[h1]What has changed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Futureproofed the game to all display technologies (high-Hz, G-SYNC, FreeSync, odd-Hz)
[*]Better experience for VRR (variable refresh rate), FreeSync, G-SYNC, and high-Hz
[*]Better experience for monitors with refresh rates not divisible by 60 (e.g. 75Hz, 144Hz)
[*]Far less stuttering/jittering while walking
[*]The game behaves better with fluctuating framerates, and framerates not divisible by 60, even on 60Hz monitors.
[*]More consistent mousefeel experience, no more "lagfeel yo-yo" effect from the sync issues
[/list]

Now, depending on your system specs, you might still experience hickups in heavy load or culling scenarios (i.e. much more detail becomes visible all of a sudden), but this effect should be reduced, especially on high-end systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/644963ad74f9ea01eb72aa8386df5460153276bd.png[/img]

To make use of variable refresh rates supported by G-SYNC or FreeSync, you can make these settings:

[b]NVIDIA Control Panel:[/b]
Monitor Technology = G-SYNC
Vertical Sync = ON

[b]In-Game:[/b]
Vertical Synch = OFF
Framerate Limit = 1000

If your GPU is running hot, you can still use the in-game framerate limiter, which now works much better and 60fps now feels a lot "faster" than before. You can also use the framerate limiter in RivaTuner Statistics Server (RTSS), which works a bit smoother than what Unity provides. In this case you will have to put the framerate limit in-game to uncapped (1000).

[h1]Soundtrack Changes:[/h1]

We've added 3 new tracks:
[b]"Tick Tock"[/b]
This one was in the game before, but not part of the Soundtrack DLC yet. It's used only once in the game. Can you guess where?

[b]"It's like Floating"
"Stimulant"[/b]
These two are completely new tracks, played while driving or exploring on foot.

ː2017stickydrinkː

Cloudpunk will be [b]25% OFF[/b] for the rest of Summer Sale. So take a drink in a coconut and enter the city of Nivalis. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/306af2da37ebb790d5711fee7d76bd3ccc81a61b.png[/img]

You are welcome to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali. We would also like to thank community member [b]Mark Rejhon[/b] of Blur Busters for his assistance and comprehensive testing of the stuttering issues.


Control out.

notes.title: Surround Sound modes, FPS unlock and more
notes.content:
We hope you're all enjoying the Summer Sale. Here's a small update that we just patched.
What has changed?

[list]
[*]Added support for changing the audio speaker setup. The following modes are supported: Mono, Stereo, Quad (4 speaker setup), Surround (5 speaker setup), 5.1, 7.1 and ProLogic DTS.
On startup the game detects what the audio driver currently supports. If you change an option, you might have to restart the game for some looping background sounds like rain to re-appear.
[*]Added an option to remove the 120fps limit, which was used if V-Sync is turned OFF. This opens support for FreeSync or G-SYNC support beyond 120fps.
[*]By default the game uses a borderless fullscreen window. If you want Cloudpunk to use exclusive fullscreen, you can add the following command line parameter under "Set Launch Options" in the Cloudpunk Steam properties:
-window-mode exclusive
[*]When buying or selling the Retro Antenna or Plasteel Bumpers for your vehicle, the parked vehicle is now updated right away and not only when entering it again.
[*]Added a safety measure to prevent the game from saving corrupted savegames in case of hardware failure. This is a rare case, but should not affect your game progress. Savegames are now written to a temporary file first, then verified and copied over the actual save file.
[*]When selling items from your inventory, the selected item will only reset if the last item from the selected stack was sold. This is relevant for player with game controllers.
[*]Fixed a crash happening on AMD graphics cards.
[/list]

Enjoy your time in Nivalis and come say "Hi" on our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url].

Your ION LANDS team

notes.title: Summer Update (Midweek Madness 25% OFF)
notes.content:
To celebrate the beginning of summer, we're happy to reveal a [b]Midweek Madness[/b] sale with [b]25% OFF[/b].

While working on more long-term updates, we've just released a small update including a range of improvements and fixes.

What has changed:
[list]
[*]Implemented a savegame rolling backup system. Whenever the game is saved, the current save will be backed up and so will the two saves before that. This is mainly intended for scenarios when your hardware crashes during a save process. This is really rare, but we'd like to prevent it affecting your savegame. So if that happens to you and you can't continue with your game, please either restore one of the backups yourself or contact us directly for assistance at support@ionlands.com 
[*]All voiceover sounds played while in your car have been reprocessed and upgraded for a more interesting effect. This will not change the lines by characters talking to you remotely, like Control.
[*]Fixed a bug when clicking an item in your inventory with your mouse and then hovering to another, which would result in both items being highlighted.
[*]Fixed a bug with moving platforms when running onto them while they are still moving up. It could sometimes cause a situation where the activator stayed green and the platform would only start moving after you left it and entered it again.
[*]Fixed an advertisement vehicle in the Marrow not displaying the billboards all the time.
[*]Tweaked the position of the first person camera. It has been lowered a bit to be exactly at the height of Rania's eyes. We've also slightly lowered the name and interaction UI's on other characters.
[*]When buying apartment upgrades and leaving the window, a savegame is now triggered. There was a confusing situation when you bought something, then left the game without a savegame being triggered and wondering where your stuff was.
[/list]

You are welcome to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali. 

Also, enjoy the new Cloudpunk key visual:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/4d8b17f28ef6f0f33aced84dcc5cbacb85568c6d.png[/img]

Control out.

notes.title: First Person Camera, Input Update and more
notes.content:
Over the last couple of weeks we've been overhauling the camera system by adding 2 new modes: [b]Third Person View[/b] and [b]First Person View[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/dd22b0cd1ab8b36e7fba7b3411db38c6634de43f.png[/img]

[h3]Third Person View[/h3]
To unlock your camera and enter third person view you can press X (default). The camera can be rotated around the player with your mouse or the right stick on your controller. When you start walking forward, the player will always walk where your camera is headed. You can also strafe and walk backward. 
Use your mouse wheel to change the distance to the player. Zooming in will ultimately switch to...

[h3]First Person View[/h3]
For full immersion, enter this mode by zooming in the camera all the way until the player disappears. Freely look around with either your mouse or the right stick on your controller. See things that you haven't seen before. But be prepared to see what the world is made of: [b]Voxels[/b]. Lots of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/a6cfa2cd7c84b3ad38a96c756443ceee7ffe8bf2.png[/img]

Decide yourself which camera mode suits your play style best.

[h3]Vehicle Camera[/h3]
The vehicle camera got an upgrade as well. You can now keep the camera unlocked while driving. Look around freely while you drive. 
One of our long-term plans is adding a full first person cockpit view while driving. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/394f506859fc81c84d666b69560e27cf4fb6d1d6.png[/img]

[h3]Mouse Steering[/h3]
Upon request we've added mouse steering for all the keyboard+mouse users. Adjust the mouse sensitivity in the menu to your liking. But please note that the vehicle will not turn more quickly this way. To use mouse steering effectively, it is recommended to use slow & steady left and right moves. 

[h3]Key Bindings[/h3]
The input and key binding system has been overhauled completely as well. It now allows full customization of controller keys. If you like, you could both accelerating, braking, steering left & right to the left stick and use the trigger keys for something else. Your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/bc8aece160114ea9e9f16a1eecb5f5291921c5b3.png[/img]

Furthermore, wherever input actions are referenced in the user interface (i.e. A to TALK), these icons now show the current key binding for either keyboard or controller users. We've also improved the input tutorials at the start of the game and added new tutorials for the camera and overmap.

[h3]Cleaning Robots[/h3]
A welcome addition to the streets of Nivalis are the new cleaning robots. They move from puddle to puddle to clean them up, a hopeless task with the endless rain pouring onto the streets. But they're cute looking and we love them.

Other changes in this update include a range of bugfixes and tweaks to support the new camera modes. We have started working on other more long-term new features and new stories and can't wait to share them with you soon. 

Until then, enjoy your time in Nivalis and come say "Hi" on our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url].

Your ION LANDS team

notes.title: Developer Livestream, Performance & Bugfixes
notes.content:
It's been nearly two weeks since we launched Cloudpunk and we're overwhelmed by the reception. Many of you have joined our official [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] to give feedback, tell us your suggestions or simply to share your love for the game. It's been really heart-warming for us and we want to thank you all for that.

We've had discussions in the team about the future of the game and decided to do a livestream on Youtube:
[h3][b]Saturday, May 9th, at 5PM CET[/b]
[url=https://youtu.be/_hXNYL-qdcU]Cloudpunk - Dev Stream[/url][/h3]

The livestream will be with Thomas, Roman, Eloise and Marko and we want to chat a bit about the game's development and our long-term vision for the game.

We've also worked on some more fixes and QoL changes in this update.

What has changed:
[list]
[*]Many performance changes. Lower quality levels now have much more impact as they also scale the amount of background vehicles and NPCs. Performance is also increased slightly in the High and Maximum levels because of improved character updating.
[*]It is no longer possible to get locked by Huxley or Pashta. Colliders of interactable NPCs on the streets have been reduced.
[*]Improved the quest removal during the Spire CEO prank choice.
[*]Fixed a rare situation in which talking to a CORPSEC character in the Stacks blocked progress near the gate at Alexa Theatre.
[*]Fixed voiceover lines stopping before the end when skipping and advancing the text.
[*]Fixed some map icons not being displayed or displayed too long.
[*]Fixed the unlocked vehicle camera not being reset properly.
[*]Fixed an empty dialog line with Emit.
[*]Japanese language fixes
[/list]

One more thing, if you're having trouble with your controller not working properly, here's what you can do:

1. Make sure only one controller is connected
2. Activate Xbox configuration support in your Steam settings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/beed264d3cc94791ca8f61a9bca667c93459bdf5.png[/img]


You are welcome to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali. 

Control out.

notes.title: Map Improvements, Performance, Key Bindings
notes.content:
This update is mainly about map and radar improvements. Our long-term vision for the game sees the map as an important feature supporting exploration.

What has changed:
[list]
[*]Radar and map only show icons of characters and other interactable objects, if that interaction is currently possible.
[*]There are now different icons for loot (items that are mainly for selling) and other items that might have a use for the story. Some can be considered in both categories (like Coolant), but these can always be bought from merchants if needed to repair a lift for example.
[*]Added a legend to the map for all currently displayed icons.
[*]Added labels for the destinations of ascenders (vehicle lifts).
[*]Improved zooming and panning the map.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/28b61f47d52e5181b1dfd3aedd49e2904002a97c.png[/img]

Regarding performance and top-model GPUs like NVIDIA's 2080s running hot, we have introduced an option to limit the frame rate. After performing tests with players from the community (thank you!) limiting the framerate to 60 helps with the overheating and could also prevent crashes. 
Please also make sure that in your graphics card control panel under 3D Settings the option "Power Management" is set to "Optimal Power". 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/573f506a0676232c778a29144d74fa8ddc07cf8e.jpg[/img]
You don't need to pull every last bit of performance out of your cards, it's better to keep them running at decent load. In your settings you can create a profile for Cloudpunk with moderate settings. 

Furthermore we've been working on some more fixes and improvements.

Other changes:
[list]
[*]Included some of the post processing effects (of which there are plenty in Cloudpunk) to the quality levels. This includes volumetric lighting, fxaa and a skybox fog blending effect, which is now more detailed in the maximum quality level.
[*]Added an option to switch bloom on/off.
[*]Fixed a bunch of spelling errors in the dialog lines.
[*]Fixed a duplicate dialog with Mala.
[*]Added key binding options for Strafe Left/Right for keyboard users. Furthermore the controls menu has been revamped and key binding improved. Tertiary key bindings (i.e. supporting WASD, controller and arrow keys at the same time) have been removed. If you are an arrow key user, bind them. Fixed accidentally binding keys twice that would cause conflicts.
[*]Added missing minimap to TV tower.
[/list]

You are welcome to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali. 

Control out.

C:/Users/YourUsername/AppData/LocalLow/Ion Lands/Cloudpunk

notes.title: More fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your continued feedback! We've been working tirelessly on some more issues you reported and managed to fix a bunch more in this update.

What has changed:
[list]
[*]Tweaked visibility (culling) of all lifts in the game.
[*]Tweaked the navpoint colors for higher contrast when multiple of them are active at the same time.
[*]Fixed wet footstep sounds while in apartment.
[*]Added an input control to disable the HUD (default: F3/DPad-Down).
[*]Added an option to invert X-Axis for the unlocked camera.
[*]Edited the Ventz level and lighting hoping to fix a crash with AMD-GPU's.
[*]Improved the dialog flow by adding a Dialog Delay option. Before, we had a bit of delay after each line. Let me elaborate on that to explain our reasoning. If you're not fluent with the English voice lines and have to read the translations, a delay is required to have a chance to grasp everything. Now you can decide in the options if you want that delay or not. By default it is off for English and on for all other languages. There is also a third value allowing you to make the delay longer if you desire.
[*]Fixed the dialog skipping for lines where one voice sample contains multiple text lines.
[*]Fixed a rare critical situation with moving platforms causing player errors after using them.
[*]Fixed holes in the CORA level.
[*]Added options to tweak the values of the GPU based culling solution we're using. One lets you change the culling accuracy (10-90%, the higher the value, the more objects are not rendered), the other is culling prediction (0-50%, culling prediction tries to predict what the camera is about to "see" next). If you are experiencing stutters, you can try to increase the prediction and see if it helps. Besides that we will look into further updates of the culling algorithm in the future to improve your experience.
[*]Fixed missing characters in Chinese, Korean and Japanese UI texts.
[*]Fixed a situation in which all available slots of a parking lot are used by NPC cars.
[*]Incoming calls will now wait before leaving the overmap if you have that open.
[/list]

We will continue looking into other reported issues and suggested improvements. Feel free to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali. They are lovely people, CorpSec will make sure of that. ːRaccoonː

Control out.

notes.title: Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your continued feedback! We've been working tirelessly on some more issues you reported and managed to fix a bunch more in this update.

What has changed:
[list]
[*]Added quality levels to the option menu: 
[olist]
[*][b]Simple[/b]: No dynamic shadows, low resolution textures, uses lowest detail of available objects only, no soft particles, no realtime reflection probes
[*][b]Medium[/b]: Low resolution dynamic shadows, low shadow shadow distance, realtime reflection probes
[*][b]High (default)[/b]: High resolution dynamic shadows, standard shadow distance, uses standard LOD bias, soft particles
[*][b]Maximum[/b]: Higher shadow distance, renders high detail object variants much further away
[/olist]
[*]Added an option "Run In Background" which allows to enable whether the game should keep running when out of focus (default: on)
[*]Added a "Sell" button to the dialog window when trade offers are displayed. This indicates that you can sell items to this merchant. It opens the inventory where you can choose which items to sell and their prices in the details. If you haven't found out yet, merchants buy and sell items at different prices depending on where they are located. Find the ones who sell low and those who buy high to make a couple extra Lims.
[*]Fixed the achievements "Above the Clouds" and "Almost like Home".
[*]Fixed many spots where the player could potentially get stuck or the camera could clip into buildings.
[*]Also added a safety net feature. In the rare case you would fall through the floor, you will be teleported back to the last saved spot.
[*]Fixed a timing issue with the Huxley office mission.
[*]Fixed and improved the timing of the Baz mission. My ears are hurting now.
[*]Fixed a bug preventing area transitioning when opening the map or menu when entering vehicle ascenders.
[*]Added a missing voiceover sample for Camus.
[/list]

We will continue looking into other reported issues and suggested improvements. Feel free to join our [url=discord.gg/cloudpunk]Discord Server[/url] for a direct chat with us and other Nivali. They are lovely people, we promise. ːRaccoonː

We are very happy that you like our game and that you would love more content. So do we.
Cloudpunk is only the beginning for us exploring the city of Nivalis. Once we ironed out the systems, we will begin to think about what's next. New deliveries, new characters, new stories, more of the city, more mechanics, the options are endless. First and foremost our main priority is making your time in Nivalis an experience, something you can't really describe, but that you can feel. <3

Control out.

notes.title: Cloudpunk is out now!
notes.content:
On behalf of the whole Cloudpunk team, we just wanted to take a moment to send a special thank you to our supporters on Steam. The enthusiasm for the game from the fans has driven us to work hard on making the world of Nivalis as beautiful, wondrous and weird as our imaginations would allow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/061955877482033764008def128c80ee537eaa7a.png[/img]

Nivalis is brought to life by its colourful characters and the stories they tell, but also by an evocative soundtrack, and a cast of talented voice actors. The beautiful city is the result of hard work by the programming team and the level designers, who have created a multi-levelled, realistic, living and breathing city that also serves as the cyberpunk playground for our story to play out.

It’s been a privilege to be part of this team, and we are all proud of the final game we have made. Every step of the way, we had cyberpunk fans cheering us on, and for that we want to say a big thank you.

We can’t wait to hear what you think of Rania’s story during her first night working in Nivalis. Cloudpunk is filled with intrigue, humour, darkness and hope, and we hope you love playing it as much as we loved making it.

[b]Welcome to Cloudpunk![/b]

[h2]If you need help[/h2]
We have done a lot of testing on different hardware, but with thousands more players, some will likely run into technical issues. The game is very demanding.
If you experience any technical issues, please send us a message to [b]support@ionlands.com[/b] and we will try to help you as fast as we can. Here's what you can do before:

[olist]
[*] Check the minimum requirements on Steam
[*] Keep your graphics driver updated to the latest stable version
[*] Try disabling anti-virus software or add Cloudpunk to its whitelist
[/olist]

If you contact us, please include your system specs and a log file called output_log.txt, that you can find here:
C:/Users/YourUsername/AppData/LocalLow/Ion Lands/Cloudpunk

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/183a203bab8f8993389ca8b78f066ef8d6c240eb.jpg[/img]

It's been nearly 3 years since I started working on the first prototypes with tiny little blocks called voxels. To be honest, it was a long and stressful journey. notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
We have reached early 2020 and we wanted to let you know that we can reveal the launch date very soon. There are so many things to consider when selecting a launch date. 
We are incredibly happy about the game's reception here on Steam so far. Since we brought the page online, Cloudpunk has collected more than 85,000 wishlists, which is incredible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/061955877482033764008def128c80ee537eaa7a.png[/img]

In December we started our voiceover casting calls, listened to hundreds of voice actors and thousands of samples to find the right ones. And we're happy to say that we did. There are over 95 characters in the game and nearly all of them have unique voices. We can't wait to let you hear them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/e1d11a1883975aa8f05b14317d688163f0858b22.jpg[/img]

We also can't wait to let you experience the game. As you know we are going for a very atmospheric, narrative driven game. It's all about the experience of being in this cyberpunk world, learning about the city and its inhabitants and enjoying the music. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/c7b3fa31cbd2823146a3d872ec821aa30db41cfd.jpg[/img]

Right now we're adding the last bits and pieces and optimize performance. Voxel art is difficult to automatically LOD, so we had to create all the LODs manually, a time consuming process.
QA starts next week and localization work is already underway. 

With the help of our newly announced partners for console (Merge Games) we are able to present the game at both PAX East (Feb 27 to Mar 1) and GDC (March 16-20). We hope to make the reveal of the PC launch date inbetween these two events.


As always, let us know your thoughts and questions in the comments below.

Marko

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
When development began on [b]Cloudpunk[/b] back in the summer of 2017, it was just me working on various prototypes while our newborn baby boy explored his first months on this planet. Things were very uncertain and hectic in these times. All I knew and felt was the vision for the game I wanted to make. Later that year I began sharing glimpses of it on social media and the exciting reception by press and players alike was so very encouraging. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lmvgx2B0qKFlUBSemf/giphy.gif[/img]

Since then I’ve been working full time on the game and began growing the team welcoming Thomas our writer, Harry our composer, Billy our portrait artist and Eloise our voxel queen. The art changed a lot and we were able to distill the gameplay to something we believe this game and the story needs. 

I initially thought the game would take around 2 years to complete, so until around fall 2019. There are so many moving pieces and after the positive responses we received, we realized we had new ideas to explore. We now know we will need a bit more time and [b]aim for release in early 2020[/b]. The coming weeks and months will make this goal much clearer and we can’t wait to announce a date once we know it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33897382/a13d0c7df58f2d96bc64bf3b1828c09b4ef40f5d.gif[/img]

We were lucky to partner with Maple Whispering to support us with the PC launch in Asia, a private investor and yet another partner who we can’t wait to reveal very soon. Now the team is growing even more with additional artists and designers helping to flesh out the world. We welcomed Roman, Rebecca, Sergey, Maryam, Kenze Wee, Gordon and Peter, some of which work full time and others half time. I’m proud of you all.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/f94VluJwFCb6fAyUPx/giphy.gif[/img]

So, while things are still very hectic, they have turned much more certain and that’s wonderful. Our next stops are [b]EGX Berlin[/b] and [b]Day of the Devs[/b], where demos will be playable on the show floor. 

As always, let us know your thoughts in the comments below.

Marko

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/5f0ff296b98388d8d1e980d98878815a2f08baac.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

Today I thought to give you an update on how things are progressing and show you a little bit of what's going on behind the scenes.

For those of you seeing this game for the first time, in Cloudpunk you play a courier driving around the sprawling city of Nivalis. On your jobs you will meet interesting, often whimsical, characters whose lives you will affect one way or another. Here are a few of them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/543b4265635f0efacd50efac5e9a413c929ff3fc.png[/img]

You will explore the entire city from the ancient, dark ground to the Spires piercing the thick layer of clouds that hides the sunlight.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/0d9590daf03623863fe568d91b91ccf15f9036bd.png[/img]

What makes this game special is that we're creating everything with voxels - small cubes that form complex buildings, vehicles and characters. Here you can see a screenshot from MagicaVoxel, the free software we're using for all the voxel editing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/2215f221c3c6d05464bf9e84d93fbbf17a17ba56.png[/img]

Exploring Nivalis you will drive, walk, discover hidden places, items and unlock the stories of the characters you meet. On your delivery jobs you will have choices, and these choices will have a lasting impact on the characters involved. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/cd423d864020cf439c771f3926f4d0ffe59b48d8.png[/img]

The story will be told entirely through dialog, which will come with full voiceovers. For each of the characters we do castings to find the right voices for all of them. This is the fun part in game development.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33897382/cc9f478286c9b1e56b4d472db806314bde8a3474.png[/img]

So right now we're working hard on fleshing out the environment. Building a city is no easy task and takes time. We hope you enjoyed these screenshots.
I'm sure you would like to know more about the release date. At the moment we can't be more specific. To sweeten the wait, you can head over to our Twitter, where I post short clips from time to time.

Talk soon,
ION LANDS

notes.title: We're happy to reveal Cloudpunk
notes.content:
We are very excited to reveal our next game Cloudpunk, a stylish story-driven cyberpunk game with a unique voxel aesthetic.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/746850/Cloudpunk

Become a courier driver for Cloudpunk Inc., the semi-legal delivery company based in the sprawling city of Nivalis. You go everywhere, from the Marrow below to the spires that pierce the grey clouds high above before scraping the edge of the troposphere. No delivery job is too dangerous, and no one is faster than a Cloudpunk driver.

In this story-based cyberpunk game, you will meet a diverse range of characters including androids, AI and unscrupulous humans at every level of society. Everyone has a story to tell, and in the course of one night in Nivalis, everything will change.

Cloudpunk will come for PC aiming a release in 2019.

[h1]Youtube Trailer:[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A-QQ5R52PZA
The trailer on Youtube contains subtitles in English, German, Russian, Japanese, Chinese (simplified), French, Spanish and Portuguese

[h1]Discord[/h1]
You are welcome to join our official Discord Server via the following link: https://discord.gg/cloudpunk

See you,
ION LANDS
